strings.milestone.body.today: Aroomi is celebrating today with the two of you.
strings.milestone.body.late: Your milestone was on {date}. Aroomi is celebrating a little late.
strings.milestone.suggest.hint: A ready-made idea from the app, no AI
strings.milestone.suggest.busy: Your partner is decorating, so the idea isn't available right now.
strings.milestone.suggest.full: The room is full, so nothing can be added. Remove an item to see the idea.
strings.milestone.suggest.partial: The room is nearly full, so only {n} items were placed.
strings.milestone.preview.note: This is the app's own idea, with no AI. Apply it only if you like it.
strings.milestone.preview.changes: {n} party items (cake, balloons, ribbon) and 1 text
strings.notif.prompt.title: Want Aroomi to remind you on milestones?
strings.notif.prompt.body: On days like 50, 100 or your anniversary, this device will notify you at 9:00 am (room time zone). The notification has no names or dates, and you can turn it off anytime in Settings.
strings.notif.prompt.note: Your device will ask for notification permission next.
